verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API with key auth, rate limits, dated versioning, an OpenAPI spec, and an MCP server that can pull messages and call history. None of it mentions registrable outbound webhooks or event callbacks for call or message events. Pull-based API and MCP access is an adjacent capability, not push delivery, so the applicable webhooks axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, call and message events arrive as webhooks I can wire into my own systems
